verdict.rationale: Fellow's homepage claims admins can set organization-wide policies for how meetings are accessed, while giving teams control over what they share. That is a first-party but thin marketing statement about sharing and access governance. Everything else in the pack covers adjacent controls (MCP governance, Super Admin data export, retention), which earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace sharing permissions, admin visibility or audit of what has been shared, in-depth docs, independent corroboration.
